<aside class="article--excerpt-meta"><span style="color: color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px;" class="article--excerpt-meta-item">REAL Watersports</span></aside>
<h2 style="color: #fff;" class="article--excerpt-title desktop-big">
<meta charset="utf-8"> <span>La Ventana SuperCamp</span> 2027</h2>
<div class="article--excerpt-text rte mt-0">
<p style="color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8);" class="lead mt-0"><meta charset="utf-8"> <meta charset="utf-8"> <span>We’re going to La Ventana, Mexico in February 2027 with another edition of the SuperCamp!</span><br></p>
<p class="mt-0"><meta charset="utf-8"> <span>REAL and Strut Kiteboarding have partnered to present the ultimate 5-Star kite and wing foil getaway.</span></p>
<p class="mt-0"><meta charset="utf-8"> <span>This means you’ll receive the incredible service and expertise you’d expect from REAL, plus coaching from professional athletes Brandon Scheid and Sensi Graves.</span></p>
<p class="mt-0"><span> <meta charset="utf-8"> Join us in La Ventana one of the most ideal windsports locations in the world! </span></p>
<p class="mb-0"><a href="https://www.realwatersports.com/products/la-ventana-supercamp-2026" class="btn btn-lg btn-primary">Book Now</a></p>
</div>

<div class="media-body">
<h6 class="my-0 text-white">
<meta charset="utf-8"> <span>La Ventana SuperCamp 2027</span>
</h6>
<p class="mt-0"><meta charset="utf-8"> <meta charset="utf-8"> <span>Join us for the adventure of a lifetime. To book your trip, click the button below and contact a REAL Pro today!</span><br></p>
<p class="mb-0"><a class="btn btn-primary" href="https://www.realwatersports.com/products/la-ventana-supercamp-2026">Book Now</a></p>

<div class="col-md-8">
<div class="bg-white mb-4" id="list-item-01">
<div class="p-4">
<h2 class="m-0 h1">La Ventana SuperCamp 2027</h2>
<h3 class="m-0"><small class="text-muted"> <meta charset="utf-8"> <span>Join our co-ed Kiteboarding &amp; Wingfoiling Adventure</span> </small></h3>
</div>
<div class="row">
<div class="col-md-12"><iframe title="YouTube video player" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/A_IdaJI7kso?si=vuXzNWU7TgllJe6C" height="315" width="560"></iframe></div>
</div>
<div class="p-4">
<p>Connect with like-minded wind enthusiasts at REAL &amp; Strut Kiteboarding’s SuperCamp designed for everyone who loves to ride the wind! Whether you're coming as a couple looking to share the experience or a solo rider seeking to expand your community, this camp brings together men and women, kiteboarders and wingfoilers, in one incredible adventure.</p>
<p>We invite you to join us in stunning La Ventana, Mexico, offering our exclusive group the perfect kite-in, kite-out experience. No need to stress about planning—we've handled everything so you can focus on improving your skills, pushing your boundaries, and making lasting connections. With personalized coaching to help you overcome challenges and build confidence both on and off the water, this camp creates the perfect environment for growth, adventure, and pure riding joy.</p>
<ul>
<li>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<p>6 Days / 7 Nights</p>
</li>
<li>February 6-13</li>
</ul>
<p class="mb-0"><a href="https://www.realwatersports.com/products/la-ventana-supercamp-2026" class="btn btn-lg btn-primary">Book Now</a></p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="bg-white mb-4" id="list-item-02">
<div class="p-4">
<h2 class="m-0 h1">Participants and Pricing</h2>
</div>
<img class="img-fluid m-0" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/2062/5873/files/A19A5257.jpg?v=1758723280">
<div class="p-4">
<p><meta charset="utf-8"> <strong><span data-contrast="none" lang="EN-US" class="TextRun MacChromeBold SCXW4554769 BCX0"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW4554769 BCX0"><span>La Ventana SuperCamp 2027 is open to wing foilers of all levels, plus intermediate and advanced kiters.</span> </span></span></strong><br></p>
<p><b><span dir="auto">Contact a REALPro at</span><span> </span><a href="tel:252.987.6000" data-auth="NotApplicable" target="_blank"><span class="x_s3">252.987.6000</span></a><span> or </span><a href="mailto:REALpro@realwatersports.com" data-auth="NotApplicable" target="_blank"><span class="x_s3">REALpro@realwatersports.com</span></a> to book today<span>.</span></b></p>
<p><strong>Required Abilities</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<meta charset="utf-8"> <span>Kite: Staying upwind confidently</span>
</li>
<li>
<meta charset="utf-8"> <span>Wing: All levels</span>
</li>
<li>
<meta charset="utf-8"> <span>Foil Drive: Self-sufficient, beach launching and riding waves</span>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Pricing</strong></p>
<p><meta charset="utf-8"> <span>Wing Foil/Kite/Foil Drive Per Person</span></p>
<ul>
<li>
<meta charset="utf-8"> <span class="EOP SCXW149650070 BCX0" data-ccp-props='{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335557856":16777215,"335559738":0,"335559739":0}'><span>Ultra Premium Double: $8590 ($4295 /person)</span> </span>
<ul>
<li><span><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">Private penthouse suite for two</span></span></li>
<li><span><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">Private balcony</span></span></li>
<li><span><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">Direct waterfront views</span></span></li>
<li>
<span><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">Shared king bed</span></span><span><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody"></span></span>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<ul>
<li>
<meta charset="utf-8"> <span>Premium Double: $7990 ($3995 / person)</span>

<h2 class="m-0 h1">Travel Information</h2>
<h3 class="m-0"><small class="text-muted"> <meta charset="utf-8"> <span>Options for traveling to La Ventana</span> </small></h3>
</div>
<img class="img-fluid m-0" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/2062/5873/files/A19A4447.jpg?v=1758724753">
<div class="p-4">
<p><meta charset="utf-8"> <meta charset="utf-8"> <span>Book your flight into/out of Cabo San Lucas (SJD) arriving any time before 6 pm on February 6th and mid-afternoon or later on February 13th. We will coordinate your shuttles and will try to group everyone together for ride shares.</span><br></p>
<p><span> <meta charset="utf-8"> The cost per person on the group shuttle is $60 each way. Any reservations that require a private shuttle can be booked at a cost of $120 each way. </span> <strong></strong><strong></strong></p>
<p><span class="EOP SCXW152411730 BCX0" data-ccp-props='{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335557856":16777215,"335559738":240,"335559739":240}'> <meta charset="utf-8"> <b data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">Travel Insurance is strongly recommended.</b><span>  <a href="https://mywatermens.rentalguardian.com/programs">Here is a trusted resource affiliated with Watermen's Retreat.</a></span> </span></p>

<div class="bg-white mb-4" id="list-item-04">
<div class="p-4">
<h2 class="m-0 h1">
<meta charset="utf-8"> <span>Information About La Ventana</span>
</h2>
<h3 class="m-0"><small class="text-muted"> <meta charset="utf-8"> <span>About La Ventana</span> </small></h3>
</div>
<img class="img-fluid m-0" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/2062/5873/files/CasaCortez.jpg?v=17582923895">
<div class="p-4">
<p><meta charset="utf-8"> <span>La Ventana is a laid-back fishing village &amp; now kiteboarding town located on the Baja Californa Sur peninsula located about 2 1/2 hours from Cabo San Lucas. As the thermal picks up around mid-morning, the wind funnels between the mainland and Cerralvo Island and blows side onshore consistently from November to April. The Sea of Cortez has been referred to as “the world’s aquarium” due to the abundance of sea life.</span></p>
<p><span> <meta charset="utf-8"> The Wind: </span></p>
<p><meta charset="utf-8"> <span>The peak of the windy season is December to March. It is typically a midday thermal that gets accelerated by a venturi effect as the wind funnels onshore between the island and mainland. Typical sessions start around 11am and last until the sun starts to set at about 5pm. The wind is side-on-shore from the Northeast direction. This makes the mornings perfect for sup-ing or walking on the beach plus a full day of sessions.</span></p>
<p><meta charset="utf-8"> <span>Your extended time on the water at our La Ventana SuperCamp will dramatically improve your ability level. Our camps provide an empowering group setting to learn beginner to advanced skills. You can expect us to be on the beach or the water for 2-4 hours/day (conditions permitting) where we will offer extra support and pointers for jump-starting your progression. Brandon, Sensi and Nadja have over 40+ years of combined windsports experience and bring this expertise to your most difficult hurdles.</span></p>
<p><span> <meta charset="utf-8"> Spend a week with us to receive consistent and thoughtful feedback and incorporate these pointers into your wing foiling, Foil Drive and kiteboarding at your own pace throughout the camp. </span></p>
<p><span> <meta charset="utf-8"> Example trip goals: Gain confidence, meet friends, first jumps, nail your first tack, riding toeside, upwind progression, backrolls, unhooked tricks, getting comfortable on your surfboard, learning to ride a foil board, jumping higher, have a great vacation </span></p>
<p>EXAMPLE SCHEDULE:</p>
<p>· 7:00 - Arise and enjoy coffee OR sleep in - your choice!</p>
<p>· 8:00 - Morning beach walk</p>
<p>· 9:00 -Scrumptious and healthy breakfast</p>
<p>· 10:00 - Yoga flow</p>
<p>· 11:00 - First session</p>
<p>· 1:30 - Lunch! Refuel with local ceviche</p>
<p>· 2:00 - Afternoon session</p>
<p>· 6:30 - Group dinner</p>
<p>· 9:00 - Phew. Lights out.</p>
<p><strong>Weather</strong></p>
<p><meta charset="utf-8"> <span>The air temp is warm and water is cool-ish. Bring your bikinis + board shorts &amp; tanks for mornings in the sun and your full 3/2 wetsuit and hoodies for when the wind picks up.</span></p>
<p class="mb-0"><a href="https://www.realwatersports.com/products/la-ventana-supercamp-2026" class="btn btn-lg btn-primary">Book Now</a></p>

<p><strong>Accommodations</strong></p>
<p><meta charset="utf-8"> <meta charset="utf-8"> <span>Stay right on the beach with kiteboarding just steps away at The Kite House at Casa Cortez. Enjoy luxury rooms with full amenities plus an outdoor jacuzzi, lounge chairs, a fire pit, and a yoga studio.</span><br></p>
<p>Choose from four room types for our La Ventana SuperCamp:</p>
<ul>
<li>Single – Private room for one person with a queen bed.</li>
<li>Double – Shared room for two people with twin beds.</li>
<li>Premium Double – Private suite for two with a king bed and private balcony. Offers partial water views, not direct waterfront like the Ultra Premium.</li>
<li>Ultra Premium – Private penthouse suite for two with a king bed, private balcony, and direct waterfront views.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Food</strong></p>
<p>We’re thrilled to partner with local chefs Daniela and Stefano to provide Mediterranean-style meals for the week.</p>
<p>“Our cuisine is a mix of Mediterranean/Italian flavors and traditions; infused with Baja’s freshness and magic. We cook everything from scratch and we use mainly organic produce from the beautiful farms in Baja.”</p>

<h2 class="m-0 h1">
<meta charset="utf-8"> <span>Meet Your Coaches</span>
</h2>
<h3 class="m-0 h1">
<meta charset="utf-8"> <span>Meet Brandon</span>
</h3>
<p>Brandon Scheid is a renowned figure in the world of windsports, having won the Triple-S Invitational 5 times, been named AWSI Athlete of the Year twice and has been featured on the cover of countless magazines.</p>
<p>Brandon worked with REAL as a kiteboarding coach for nearly a decade and brings over 20 years of windsports knowledge to the table. He finds immense purpose in teaching others and has a unique ability to distill complicated concepts into easily understandable language. His instruction is precise, helpful and empowering.</p>
<p>Brandon brings a level of stoke that is unparalleled and his life mission is to help other humans get more quality time on the water.</p>
<img class="img-fluid m-0" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/2062/5873/files/DSC07895.jpg?v=1758734356">
<h3>Meet Sensi</h3>
<p>Sensi Graves is a professional kiteboarder, wingfoiler, entrepreneur, and women’s empowerment speaker. She began her career coaching with REAL Watersports in North Carolina, where she quickly saw how time on the water can unlock confidence and personal growth. Since then, she’s competed internationally, launched Sensi Graves Swim, and built a career mentoring women in leadership and self-belief.</p>
<p>At Strut’s kiteboarding and wingfoiling retreats, Sensi blends her years of coaching expertise with her passion for empowerment—helping women conquer self-doubt, feel strong in their bodies, and carry the confidence they build on the water into every area of their lives.</p>
<img class="img-fluid m-0" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/2062/5873/files/A19A5444.jpg?v=1758292368"><br>
<h3>Meet Kay Kay</h3>
<p>Karolina aka Kay Kay is a 500-hour certified yoga teacher through the Yoga Alliance. She draws on her diverse training to infuse her classes with a blend of many yoga styles.</p>
<p>During camp Kay Kay provides a variety of classes that are tuned to meet our daily needs. She offers Vinyasa, Yin, and Restorative yoga practices to help you feel ahhh-mazing.</p>
<div class="bg-white mb-4" id="list-item-07">
<h2 class="m-0 h1">Suggested Kite Gear</h2>
<h3 class="m-0"><small class="text-muted"> <meta charset="utf-8"> <span>What gear should you bring for La Ventana?</span> </small></h3>
</div>
<img class="img-fluid m-0" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/2062/5873/files/46BA6992-7CB8-464D-9F7F-50F21261863B_1_105_c.jpg?v=1758737149">
<div class="p-4">
<p><strong>Considerations for Kiters</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>February in La Ventana brings consistent thermal winds and sunny, mild weather—ideal for all-day kite sessions.</li>
<li>Pack versatile kite sizes that cover light to strong winds—a mid-range freeride/all-around kite is a smart base</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Kites</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<meta charset="utf-8"> <span>2-3 freeride/all-around kites (e.g., 7m + 9 m + 12 m)</span>
</li>
<li>
<meta charset="utf-8"> <span>Optional: light-wind kite (15 m+) or smaller kite (5–8 m) if foiling</span>
</li>
<li><span>Twin-tip board (or foil board if foiling)</span></li>
<li><span>Control bar with lines</span></li>
<li><span>Kite harness</span></li>
<li><span>Board bag (if bringing your own)</span></li>
<li><span>Safety accessories: helmet, leash, pump, repair kit, valve adapter, board fins, etc.</span></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Wetsuit</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<meta charset="utf-8"> <span>Expect average water temps around 65–70 °F (18–21 °C), with air temperatures warm but not overly hot. A light wetsuit or protective clothing is recommended—sun protection is key.</span>
</li>
<li>
<meta charset="utf-8"> <span>A 3/2mm wetsuit is typically sufficient for the water temperatures in La Ventana</span>
</li>
<li>
<meta charset="utf-8"> <span>Optional: Spring suit or Short Sleeve Full, 4/3mm if forecast looks chillier</span>
</li>
<li><span>A second suit you can put on dry is great for multiple sessions per day</span></li>
</ul>
<p><a href="https://www.realwatersports.com/collections/kiteboarding" class="btn btn-primary">Shop Kite Gear</a></p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="bg-white mb-4" id="list-item-08">
<div class="p-4">
<h2 class="m-0 h1">Suggested Foil &amp; Wing Gear</h2>
<h3 class="m-0"><small class="text-muted"> <meta charset="utf-8"> <span>What Kite Foil, Foil Drive, and Wing gear should you bring for La Ventana?</span> </small></h3>
</div>
<img class="img-fluid m-0" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/2062/5873/files/A19A6483.jpg?v=1758719477">
<div class="p-4">
<p><strong>Considerations for Foilers</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<meta charset="utf-8"> <span>Wind: Expect consistent thermal winds and sunny skies, offering reliable wing-foiling conditions.</span>
</li>
<li>
<meta charset="utf-8"> <span>A flat, sandy beach with negligible shore break makes for easy launching and landings.</span><br>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Inflatable Wings</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<meta charset="utf-8"> <span>Suggested wing sizes are 3m to 6m, depending on wind conditions.</span><br>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong> <meta charset="utf-8"> <span>Wing and Foil Drive</span> </strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<meta charset="utf-8"> <strong><span class="TextRun MacChromeBold SCXW233250315 BCX0" lang="EN-US" data-contrast="none"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW233250315 BCX0">Medium to </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW233250315 BCX0">h</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW233250315 BCX0">igh-</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW233250315 BCX0">a</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW233250315 BCX0">spect </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW233250315 BCX0">f</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW233250315 BCX0">oil</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW233250315 BCX0">s</span></span></strong><span class="TextRun SCXW233250315 BCX0" lang="EN-US" data-contrast="none"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW233250315 BCX0"> </span></span><span data-ccp-props='{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335557856":16777215,"335559738":0,"335559739":0}' class="EOP SCXW233250315 BCX0"><span>prioritize efficiency and glide to maximize long rides on open ocean swells.</span></span>
</li>
<li>
<meta charset="utf-8"> <strong><span class="TextRun MacChromeBold SCXW221200109 BCX0" lang="EN-US" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW221200109 BCX0">Front Wing Siz</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW221200109 BCX0">ing</span></span></strong><span class="TextRun SCXW221200109 BCX0" lang="EN-US" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW221200109 BCX0"> </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW221200109 BCX0">d</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW221200109 BCX0">epend</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW221200109 BCX0">s</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW221200109 BCX0"> on your weight and skill level. Larger wings</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW221200109 BCX0"> </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW221200109 BCX0">can work for smaller waves or easier takeoff</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW221200109 BCX0"> while smaller wings offer </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW221200109 BCX0">additional</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW221200109 BCX0"> performance.</span></span> <meta charset="utf-8">
</li>
</ul>
<p><span data-ccp-props='{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335559738":240,"335559739":240}' class="EOP SCXW215386041 BCX0"> <strong> <meta charset="utf-8"> <span>Wing and Foil Drive</span> Boards </strong> </span></p>
<ul>
<li><span data-ccp-props='{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335559738":240,"335559739":240}' class="EOP SCXW215386041 BCX0"><strong><span class="TextRun MacChromeBold SCXW77012119 BCX0" lang="EN-US" data-contrast="none"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW77012119 BCX0">Wing Board</span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW77012119 BCX0" lang="EN-US" data-contrast="none"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW77012119 BCX0">-</span></span></strong><span class="TextRun SCXW77012119 BCX0" lang="EN-US" data-contrast="none"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW77012119 BCX0"><span> Sizing depends on your weight and skill level but a mid-length is a great choice as a single board quiver</span></span></span></span></li>
<li>
<span data-ccp-props='{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335559738":240,"335559739":240}' class="EOP SCXW215386041 BCX0"> <span class="TextRun SCXW77012119 BCX0" lang="EN-US" data-contrast="none"> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW77012119 BCX0"> <span data-ccp-props='{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335557856":16777215,"335559738":0,"335559739":0}' class="EOP SCXW242622591 BCX0"> <meta charset="utf-8"> <strong><span class="TextRun MacChromeBold SCXW206669366 BCX0" lang="EN-US" data-contrast="none"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW206669366 BCX0">Foil Drive Board</span></span></strong><span class="TextRun SCXW206669366 BCX0" lang="EN-US" data-contrast="none"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW206669366 BCX0"><strong>-</strong> </span></span><span data-ccp-props='{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335557856":16777215,"335559738":0,"335559739":0}' class="EOP SCXW206669366 BCX0"><span>A board specifically designed and set up for Foil Drive is best in addition to your wing board.</span></span> </span> </span> </span> </span> <span data-ccp-props='{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335559738":240,"335559739":240}' class="EOP SCXW215386041 BCX0"><span class="TextRun SCXW77012119 BCX0" lang="EN-US" data-contrast="none"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW77012119 BCX0"><span data-ccp-props='{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335557856":16777215,"335559738":0,"335559739":0}' class="EOP SCXW242622591 BCX0"><span data-ccp-props='{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335557856":16777215,"335559738":0,"335559739":0}' class="EOP SCXW206669366 BCX0"></span></span></span></span></span>

<p><strong>Additional Gear</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<strong>Leashes</strong>- A coiled leash for the board and a waist leash for the wing to ensure safety, ability to paddle and convenience.</li>
<li>
<strong>Pump</strong>- High-quality pump</li>
<li>
<strong>Protective Gear</strong>- Helmet &amp; impact vast</li>
<li>
<strong>Wetsuit</strong>- A 3/2mm wetsuit is typically sufficient for the water temperatures <span>in La Ventana</span>
</li>
<li>
<strong>Accessories</strong>- Foot straps and backup hardware</li>
</ul>

<div class="p-4">
<h2 class="m-0 h1">Frequently Asked Questions</h2>
<h3 class="m-0"><small class="text-muted">If you have any other questions, please contact us with the button below!</small></h3>
</div>
<img class="img-fluid m-0" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/2062/5873/files/Casa_Cortez2.jpg?v=1758734918">
<div class="p-4">
<p><strong>Drinking Water:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<meta charset="utf-8"> <span>The house provides safe drinking water on site 24/7. Tap water is safe for brushing teeth and showering.</span>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Suggested Packing:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Long &amp; short sleeved t-shirts</li>
<li>Fleece or sweatshirt</li>
<li>Lightweight pants / jeans</li>
<li>Shorts</li>
<li>Lightweight Socks</li>
<li>Comfortable Shoes</li>
<li>Sandals</li>
<li>Sunglasses</li>
<li>Sun Block, Lip Balm</li>
<li>Anti-Rash Ointment</li>
<li>Swimsuit</li>
<li>Personal First Aid Kit Including: Advil/Tylenol &amp; Anti-Diarrheal Medication</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Phone Service / WiFi:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Check with your provider about international phone coverage. Complimentary WiFi is available at the house.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Money:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><span>The currency in Mexico is the Mexican Peso. It’s not mandatory to have Pesos while visiting, but it’s recommended for ease of transactions. There are ATM’s to withdraw cash. Most places take dollars or pesos.</span></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Electricity:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<meta charset="utf-8"> <span data-contrast="none" lang="EN-US" class="TextRun SCXW233425153 BCX0"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW233425153 BCX0">You can charge all your devices using standard US 120 V electrical plugs; no adapters are needed.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW233425153 BCX0" data-ccp-props='{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335557856":16777215,"335559738":0,"335559739":0}'> </span>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Air Conditioning:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<meta charset="utf-8"> <span data-contrast="none" lang="EN-US" class="TextRun SCXW233425153 BCX0"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW233425153 BCX0">There is air conditioning in the rooms, but during the winter months, the desert cools significantly.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW233425153 BCX0" data-ccp-props='{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335557856":16777215,"335559738":0,"335559739":0}'> </span>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Gratuity:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Gratuity is optional and appreciated. A standard tip is 15-20% for Staff and Coaches.</span></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Cancellation Policy</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<meta charset="utf-8"> <span>All lessons, trips and offsites are paid in full upon booking with REAL Watersports. All sales are final.</span>
</li>
<li>
<meta charset="utf-8"> <span>If you need to cancel your La Ventana SuperCamp trip you can do so up to 120 days before the scheduled start date and receive a full credit onto your REAL account. If you cancel between 61 and 119 days before your scheduled start date, you will receive a REAL credit of 50%.</span>
</li>
<li>
<meta charset="utf-8"> <span>No REAL credit will be issued for cancellations within 60 days of the scheduled start date.</span>
</li>
<li>
<meta charset="utf-8"> <span>If the wind, waves or weather is unfavorable during the trip, REAL Watersports does not issue REAL credit or a refund. Your coach will work to provide alternative activities if wind, waves, or weather are unfavorable.</span>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="mb-0"><a href="https://www.realwatersports.com/products/la-ventana-supercamp-2026" class="btn btn-lg btn-primary">Book Now</a></p>
